target.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`loadIdentityFromFile` in `src/agents/identity-file.ts` loaded `IDENTITY.md` with `fs.readFileSync(..., "utf-8")` and no size cap. A malicious or runaway identity file in a workspace could OOM the agent identity loader before parsing even began.

## Why This Change Was Made

Identity files are small human-authored markdown; 1 MiB is generous headroom while preventing an unbounded read. The existing `catch` already returns `null` for unreadable files, so an oversized file is handled gracefully the same way.

## User Impact

- Workspace identity loading no longer buffers arbitrarily large `IDENTITY.md` files.
- Oversized identity files are treated as missing (returns `null`) instead of crashing.
- Normal identity files work exactly as before.

## Evidence

- Replaced `fs.readFileSync` with `readRegularFileSync({ filePath, maxBytes: IDENTITY_FILE_MAX_BYTES })` in `src/agents/identity-file.ts`.
- Added regression tests in `src/agents/identity-file.test.ts` covering normal load and an oversized file that exceeds the cap.
- Local test run:
  ```
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/identity-file.test.ts --run
  # 9 tests passed
  ```

## Real behavior proof

I created a workspace with an oversized `IDENTITY.md` (2 MiB) and ran `loadAgentIdentityFromWorkspace`. The loader returns `null` instead of buffering the oversized file:

```text
$ OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/identity-file.test.ts --run
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts
 RUN  v4.1.9
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/identity-file.test.ts (9 tests) 119ms
     ✓ loads identity values from IDENTITY.md
     ✓ returns null when IDENTITY.md exceeds the size cap
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  9 passed (9)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 11.05s
```

The oversized identity file is rejected with `File exceeds 1048576 bytes`, and the agent loader falls back to no custom identity rather than risking OOM.

## Real behavior proof (standalone)

A standalone Node script outside Vitest imports the changed helper directly from source and exercises both a normal and an oversized `IDENTITY.md`:

```text
$ pnpm exec tsx /tmp/proof-101447.mjs

=== Normal IDENTITY.md ===
Result: {
  "name": "Proof Agent",
  "emoji": "🧪",
  "theme": "dark"
}
Has identity values: true

=== Oversized IDENTITY.md (2 MiB) ===
loadAgentIdentityFromWorkspace result: null
Treated as missing (returns null): true

=== Underlying bounded reader behavior ===
readRegularFileSync threw: File exceeds 1048576 bytes: /tmp/proof-101447-1n22Bp/IDENTITY.md

=== Cleanup ===
Removed temp workspace: /tmp/proof-101447-1n22Bp

Standalone proof complete.
```

The proof script is `/tmp/proof-101447.mjs` and is not committed to the repo.
